name: alacritty-grid-anchors
instr:
Please add named cell anchors to `alacritty_terminal` so clients can find a cell again after the grid scrolls or resizes. Add these methods on `alacritty_terminal::grid::Grid<T>` with its existing `GridCell + Default + PartialEq` bounds:

- `grid::Grid::set_anchor`: `pub fn set_anchor(&mut self, id: u64, point: Point) -> bool`
- `grid::Grid::anchor`: `pub fn anchor(&self, id: u64) -> Option<Point>`
- `grid::Grid::remove_anchor`: `pub fn remove_anchor(&mut self, id: u64) -> Option<Point>`

Here `Point` is `alacritty_terminal::index::Point`. Each name belongs to one cell per grid; setting it again moves it, and different names may share a cell. Setting returns whether the position was accepted; removal returns the previous position. Accept only cells currently in the grid, including history, and reject `WIDE_CHAR_SPACER` and `LEADING_WIDE_CHAR_SPACER` cells. A rejected set leaves the old position alone.

Anchors follow surviving cell slots through scrolling and resizing, including reflow and wide-character movement, rather than staying at screen coordinates or following equal character values. Character insertion and deletion also move surviving slots and discard anchors on cells pushed out or deleted. Overwriting a cell retains its anchors; resetting its row or discarding the cell removes them. Anchors must not keep otherwise discarded blank cells or rows alive.
